# About Alpha-Devs
Alpha-Devs is a global software development company born from the technical mastery of FAST alumni. We specialize in bridging complex technical challenges with elegant, scalable business solutions.

## Services
- Custom Software Development
- AI & Machine Learning Solutions
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems
- Supply Chain Management
- HR Management Systems
- Sales & Scheduling Tools
- AI Agents & Automation
- Technical Consultancy

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Prisma ORM
- Deployment: Vercel
- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript

## Key Features
- Modern, responsive web applications
- High-performance solutions
- Scalable architecture
- Beautiful UI/UX design
- SEO optimized

## Company Information
- Name: Alpha-Devs
- Type: Software Development Company
- Background: FAST Alumni
- Focus: Enterprise Solutions, AI Integration, Custom Development
